name: hackathon-platform
goal: Build a hackathon management platform: teams have name, college, city, track AI/Web/Health/Sustainability/Open, project title and stage Registered/Shortlisted/Finalist/Eliminated; actions: shortlist and eliminate. Each team has many members: name, email, phone and role Leader/Developer/Designer/Presenter. Each team has many mentor sessions: mentor name, topic, date, time and status Scheduled/Completed/Cancelled; actions: complete and cancel. Each team has many judge scores: judge name, innovation 1-10, technical depth 1-10, presentation 1-10, impact 1-10 and comments. Show total teams, members per team, average judge scores, filter teams by stage and track, search teams by name, edit and delete everything.
title: Hackathon management platform: 4 modules
